knowledge_cards_add.claim: Inverse-fitted vocal FX controls are topology/loss/data-conditioned proxies, not the original engineer's identifiable settings.
Independent Gaussian or uniform sampling is a weak prior for the paper's fitted vocal-effects representation.
Observed threshold/makeup and delay-time/gain/feedback correlations motivate coupled candidate moves, not universal causal rules.
Spatial effects improved architecture-aligned inverse-fit losses but did not establish listener preference in rock mixes.
Rules from this fixed static chain need a topology gate for distortion, modulation, automation and full-mix interactions.

rules_add.name: vocal_fx_coupled_search_shadow_only
rules_add.applies_when: project-owned vocal; declared section and role; stable baseline; frozen fixed topology
rules_add.change: test one predeclared coherent vector or one scalar macro over it; never copy paper means as presets
rules_add.verify: raw measurement render plus separate section-wise BS.1770-matched blind copy; exact vector and topology frozen
rules_add.cancel: benefit only from loudness, protected-quality regression, or out-of-topology source processing

experiments_add.factor: frozen spatial-return vector bypassed versus enabled
experiments_add.variant_B: same mix with one predeclared delay+reverb return vector enabled
experiments_add.inference_limit: bundle-level only; no attribution to individual delay/reverb controls
experiments_add.loudness_match: separate section-wise BS.1770-matched blind copies; preserve raw renders
experiments_add.success: same state selected at least 2 of 3 without protected-quality regression
experiments_add.cancel: inconsistent preference, level-only benefit, or intelligibility/identity/attack/mono/depth/headroom regression
